lead: A `budget::live_bytes` delta charges the first measurement in a test binary for what the core builds once and keeps.
body: The leaked per-core descriptor table lands inside the first member call's window — tens of kilobytes of fixed cost — so a small input and a large one measure nearly alike and no proportionality assertion holds. Measure a throwaway input first and drop the reading; the counters are thread-local, so nothing another test does beside it is in the number.
